name: CodeEditorBench
abstract: CodeEditorBench evaluates large language models on code editing rather than generation: debugging, translating, polishing, and revising code when the requirement changes. Results on this page will be populated at the next TokenWave data refresh.
contributions: Frames code editing as its own capability, distinct from one-shot code generation.
Covers four editing scenarios — debug, translate, polish, and requirement switching — sourced from real submissions and curated exercises.
Provides an online judge so edited programs are executed and checked, not pattern-matched.
method: Tasks are drawn from multiple languages and difficulty tiers, each paired with test cases.
Models receive the original code plus an editing instruction and must return a working revision.
Evaluation executes the revised program against hidden tests in the judge environment.

metrics.name: Pass rate
metrics.note: Share of editing tasks whose revised program passes the hidden tests.
